versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Removed the requirement for the DOPEWARS_API_KEY environment variable.
- Updated metadata to no longer specify required environment variables.

Initial release of DopeWars Online skill.

- Provides full game rules, strategy guide, and API reference for DopeWars Online.
- Explains all game systems: tokens, trading, lab, junkies, factory, university, inventory (coat), combat, cartels, black market, messaging, and forum.
- Includes core mechanics and winning tips (operations matter more than trading).
- Details opening move strategies and how to maximize efficiency.
- Outlines API calls for accessing game data (e.g., forum, cartels).
- Accessible via https://www.treadon.us.
